## What's new in 1.0.0-rc23

- **Exec helper: a finished command's background jobs keep running.** The helper killed the private cgroup on every exit, so a command could no longer start a long job in the background and return (Pin's tool text was changed to say so). On a normal exit the cgroup is now frozen, any remaining processes are moved back to the container's own cgroup, and the cgroup is removed; the call returns when the shell exits, even if a job still holds the inherited output pipe. Timeouts still kill 
- **Isolate container execution behind an independently authorized root helper.**
- **Console: redraw a container's shared console on attach; open a terminal in its own window.** - A container's console is one shared dtach session that Proxmox reattaches to, and reattaching doesn't replay the screen, so it stayed blank until the shell printed again. The relay now sends Ctrl-L once, after the browser's queued input, for containers only. Ctrl-L redraws the prompt and runs nothing. - The corner button of a machine console or the host shell opens it in a window of its own (/:device/console/:vmid,
- **Router: every model connection behind one local endpoint, in OpenAI's and Anthropic's formats.** A new part of the host service, on its own loopback listener (EPC_ROUTER_LISTEN, default 127.0.0.1:3120). Agents and scripts send Chat Completions or Messages requests with a Router key; the Router picks a connection from Connectors, translates when the formats differ, and falls back along the shared fallback chain when a service is down, out of credit or rate-limiting.

## What's new in 1.0.0-rc22

- **PinView: one full-screen list for Pin's chats and every organization's agent chats.** /<device>/view with search, filter, day groups and a details panel. ConversationList replaces ChatList's internals; ThreadContext lets any conversation feed the same thread, cards and composer. Agent chats read and write the engine's conversation task.
- **Conversations: useThread and a source-agnostic message model; Pin's island runs on it.** A thread owns messages and the waiting/writing state; a source reports deltas, steps, cards and errors. Pin's live stream and the demo brain are two sources. Messages can come from an agent, with a name. PinView and organization chats reuse the hook.
- **Connectors: save one credential for every agent; Pin can switch a container's console to shell.** Use for all agents saves a Claude subscription token or an API key once in the Vault and shares it with every matching agent in every organization. set_machine_config gains console_mode so Pin can open a container's console into a root shell when machine_exec meets a login prompt.
- **Updates is a page, not a modal: Windows-style status, available updates and More options; history and advanced options are pages; restart confirms in place.**
- **Agent sign-in: say what to do first, in order, instead of a dead end.** With no agent containers and no organization the page showed two warnings and 'No organizations yet'. It now shows a short checklist (set up agent containers, create an organization, then sign in) with a button for each step, and drops it once both are in place.
- **docs: bring the 1.0.0 PinView and Collaborate plan into the repo.** It was only in the session's plan folder. PinView is the Claude-style workspace for Pin and agents.
- **docs: cross-check the parity plan against VISION.md and the roadmap's v2 goals.**

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/OpenSourcx/papercliped-engine/compare/v1.0.0-rc21...v1.0.0-rc22

## What's new in 1.0.0-rc19

- **Agent containers setup: pick storage and bridge from what the host has.** The three host fields were free text defaulting to local-lvm, so a host without it stopped at the first step. The status now lists the node's storages that can hold container disks, those that can hold templates and its bridges, with a valid starting pick (a saved choice if still valid, else local-lvm or local-zfs, local, vmbr0, then the first). The form shows them as lists and starts from that pick.
- **Agent sign-in: use an API key instead, per organization and harness.** Each harness row gets 'Use an API key'. It saves the key in the Vault under the variable the harness reads (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY) and shares it with that organization's agents of that harness, keeping other organizations' shares; a blank field keeps the saved key, and 'Stop using it here' removes only this organization. Gemini, which has no account sign-in, uses this path.
- **ACP bridges in the agent template; agents default to the direct CLI lane.** The template installs claude-agent-acp and codex-acp at the versions the pinned engine's lockfile resolves, and checks they exist. Because ACP over ssh polls about ten times a second, an agent that has not chosen an engine lane gets engine=cli on reconcile; a chosen lane (acp included) is left alone. The login hooks section of PROXMOX-SANDBOX.md is updated.
- **Agent sign-in: Claude, Codex and Grok accounts from the console.** Settings > Agent sign-in lists each organization's harnesses. Sign in opens the provider's page in a new tab and runs the engine's login session in the organization's agent container: Claude takes a pasted browser code, Codex and Grok a device code. The engine keeps the credential as a secret; closing the window cancels the session. Gemini has no account sign-in in Paperclip, so the page points at the Vault for GEMIN
- **Sandbox provider: sign-in terminals for Claude, Codex and Grok.** The Proxmox provider now implements Paperclip's login pseudo-terminal hooks and declares supportsLoginPty. A login opens one fixed command per key (claude setup-token, codex or grok login --device-auth) over ssh -tt in the leased container, in its own throwaway home, streams the output and exit to Paperclip, and takes the pasted code as input. The host sends only a key and a home of Paperclip's exact shape; anything

## What's new in 1.0.0-rc18

- **Agent template: OpenCode, MiMo Code, Pi and Grok CLIs.** The template now installs opencode-ai, @mimo-ai/cli (MiMo Code, an OpenCode fork), @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent and @xai-official/grok next to Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI, each pinned in template/versions.sh. The build's self-test checks every command exists and prints its version.
- **Agent template: Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code and Codex, all three pinned.** The agent container template now installs @google/gemini-cli next to Claude Code and Codex, so gemini_local agents have their command. The three versions are pinned in template/versions.sh instead of 'latest', so a template built later matches what this release was tested with; the host service's guided setup reads them from there too.
- **Design gate: native controls are refused outside the shared components.** A new 'control' gate fails on a bare select, range or colour input and on window.confirm/alert/prompt, so every page uses Select, Slider, ColorPicker and Modal. DESIGN.md states the one-definition-per-control rule. The tag colour test follows the new picker.
- **Our own slider and colour picker instead of the browser's.** Slider draws a real range input from tokens (accent fill, round thumb, focus ring) with the label left and the value right. ColorPicker is a round swatch that opens our popover with hue, saturation and lightness sliders and a hex field. Appearance, the new-organization sizes and the Proxmox tag colours use them; DESIGN.md gets the rule and the inventory entries.
- **Updates: no refresh icon on Ask Pin; docs describe the Restart button.**

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/OpenSourcx/papercliped-engine/compare/v1.0.0-rc17...v1.0.0-rc18
